Thus T subset {chi_D, chi_T, chi_B}'); its T-Comp has no transitivity clause and cannot build an S5 frame. The three named spine lemmas (8.2.4/8.2.5/8.2.6) are the wrong lemmas. The true spine is Prime Lemma 5.3.1 (Zorn over whole labelled contexts), Canonical Model Lemma 5.3.2 (box-backward via fresh label + box-intro), and Theorem 6.2.1 (Hilbert<=>labelled adequacy, which does cover IS5).
